localEquivalentBeforeStaging.providerRegistry: open-sse/providers/registry/openrouter.js: alias openrouter, apikey, Bearer, serviceKinds [llm, embedding, tts, imageToText, rerank, systemone], no video kind, no videoConfig
localEquivalentBeforeStaging.videoGenerationAdapter: none (getVideoGenerationAdapter('openrouter') is null; VIDEO_GENERATION_ADAPTERS has alibaba, ali, renderhour, adobe-firefly-api, adobe-firefly-web)
localEquivalentBeforeStaging.asyncVideoConfig: none (PROVIDER_MEDIA.openrouter has no videoConfig, so the /v1/videos proxy in videoCore.js cannot reach it)
localEquivalentBeforeStaging.otherVideosUse: none; nothing in open-sse or src sends to openrouter.ai/api/v1/videos or reads unsigned_urls

exports.createOpenrouterVideoAdapter: factory; options { timeoutMs, submitTimeoutMs, requestTimeoutMs, contentTimeoutMs, pollIntervalMs, maxPolls, wait, now } for tests
exports.buildOpenrouterVideoRequest: (model, body) -> { model, prompt, duration?: integer, aspect_ratio? }; throws status 400
exports.resolveOpenrouterTiming: (body) -> { pollIntervalMs, maxPolls } from poll_interval_ms / max_polls within the 600 s window; throws status 400
exports.runOpenrouterVideoJob: submit + bounded poll + bounded content read; { success, bytes, job, jobId } or error result with acceptedJob
exports.openrouterContentUrl: (url, jobId) same-origin content URL check for unsigned_urls[0]

provider.extraHeaders: none; the registry's HTTP-Referer / X-Title belong to chat, TTS, image, embedding and System One configs and were not sent on video by the source

models.rawIds: none; only the 14 source slugs are sent (the registry's passthroughModels applies to chat, not this adapter)
models.modelIdParsing: slugs contain one slash; openrouter/google/veo-3.1 splits on the first slash into provider openrouter and model google/veo-3.1
models.dynamicDiscovery: none in the source for video; static list only. The provider's modelsFetcher (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models, type openrouter-free) lists chat models and must not feed video

integrationPoints.change: import { openrouterVideoAdapter } and add `openrouter: openrouterVideoAdapter` to VIDEO_GENERATION_ADAPTERS; handleVideoGenerationCore calls generate and keeps acceptedJob on errors

append "video" to serviceKinds and the 14 video model rows (kind: video) from OPENROUTER_VIDEO_MODELS; keep alias, apikey auth, Bearer transport, chat headers, modelsFetcher and passthroughModels; no videoConfig (no async /v1/videos ledger)
list the OpenRouter video kind after registration
